authoring.author: Codex (implementing assistant), not an independent human author
authoring.notes: New proposals written from the eight captured Wikipedia lead sections. Assistant inspected the complete saved leads and article context; no benchmark questions were used. No paid provider. Source support is assistant-checked, not independently human-approved; aliases, ambiguity, hints and difficulty still require editorial review. Text excerpts retain separate CC BY-SA attribution.
